title: Indian Masala Spiced Sablefish (Pan-Seared Black Cod)
originalTitle: Indian Masala Spiced Sablefish (Pan-Seared Black Cod)
ingredients: 2 thick sablefish (black cod) fillets (6 oz each), skin-on and pin-bones removed
1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp ground coriander, 1/2 tsp roasted cumin, 1/2 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp thick Greek yogurt or mustard oil
1 tbsp ghee or neutral oil + 8 fresh curry leaves for pan-searing
instructions: Score the skin of the sablefish fillets lightly and pat completely dry.

Whisk together ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri chili powder, turmeric, coriander, cumin, garam masala, lemon juice, yogurt/mustard oil, and salt. Coat the flesh of the sablefish and marinate 15 minutes.
Heat ghee or oil in a cast-iron or non-stick skillet over medium-high heat with fresh curry leaves.
Sear the sablefish skin-side down for 4–5 minutes until crisp, then flip and baste with the spiced pan oil for 3–4 minutes until buttery and flaking into pearlescent layers.
